clue.text: After a little while, young girls can be sweet

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a little while
lasses are young girls

explanation.surface: Wait a moment and the young girls will turn out to be lovely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' just orders the pieces: the short wait comes first, then the girls.
explanation.definitionFit: Treacle-like syrup from sugar refining is a sweet substance, so 'sweet' used as a noun covers it.

explanation.surface: Getting the cream ready for the family pet.
explanation.definitionFit: Beating cream stiffens it; a cat-o'-nine-tails is one kind of lash used for flogging.

clue.text: Grass initially found everywhere, some cultivated, usually environmentally

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of each of the following words

parts.words: found everywhere, some cultivated, usually environmentally

explanation.surface: A grass that grows all over, some of it farmed with care for nature.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a genus of tufted pasture and lawn plants, a type of grass.

clue.text: Penny, this cheap storybook, how terrible

explanation.surface: A cheap Victorian thriller judged awful by its reader.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'penny dreadful' was a lurid serial story sold for a penny in Victorian Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Lurid penny serials were nicknamed this; separately the word is an adjective meaning awful.

clue.text: Staying away whilst remaining out of form

parts.note: keeping can mean remaining, as in keeping quiet
off means below par, out of form, as in an off day

explanation.surface: An athlete staying away from the team while still off form.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid something is to hold oneself clear of it, i.e. staying away from it.

clue.text: This land to part near Newcastle?

indicators.note: This points at the answer itself, which joined to land makes the place named

parts.note: Sunderland is a city on Wearside, close to Newcastle in north-east England
taken as written

explanation.surface: A question about splitting up some territory in north-east England.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'This + land' as a place near Newcastle: Sunderland, an English city about ten miles away; take away LAND and the remainder is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To split or sever is to divide in two, which is to part.

clue.text: Monstrous stretch of water in Scotland

definitions.text: Monstrous stretch of water in Scotland

parts.words: Monstrous stretch of water in Scotland
parts.note: monstrous is a nod to the legendary creature said to live in a famous Highland lake

explanation.surface: A Scottish lake described as huge.
explanation.definitionFit: The Highland lake is famous as the home of a legendary monster, hence monstrous.

clue.text: Pay of Sarah and Ray to be prepared

parts.note: Sal is a pet form of the name Sarah

indicators.note: prepared suggests the letters of the name are got ready in a new order

explanation.surface: Two people, Sarah and Ray, waiting for their wages to be made up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be prepared' turns RAY into ARY.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixed regular wage is pay for work.

explanation.surface: Asking whether a monkey is a factor.
explanation.definitionFit: The macaque species is named this, and the blood antigen first found in it is called the same factor.

parts.note: an asp is a venomous snake

explanation.surface: A snake from the West that bites.
explanation.definitionFit: This yellow-and-black insect carries a sting, so it is a stinger.

clue.text: Speak quite plainly and name the card correctly

explanation.surface: A card player naming the suit correctly and plainly.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means talking bluntly; literally it names the card from that suit correctly.

clue.text: An incendiary device, say, in Elba, potentially detestable

indicators.note: say signals that the words are taken as heard, so the silent final B drops away

parts.note: a bomb is an explosive or incendiary device
taken as written

indicators.note: potentially says the letters of Elba could become another word

explanation.surface: A bomb planted on the island of Elba would be detestable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' gives A BOM, as a bomb is pronounced, and 'potentially' turns ELBA into ABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hateful or loathsome is detestable.

clue.text: To do with showy adornments at the purification plant

parts.note: re means about, to do with
finery is elaborate, showy dress and decoration

explanation.surface: Fancy decorations found at a processing works.
explanation.definitionFit: A works where crude oil or sugar is cleaned of impurities is a purification plant.

indicators.note: inside places the river within the rearranged letters
another means the word uses is made into a different arrangement

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, a river; the Po is Italy's longest

explanation.surface: Someone's partner uses another flower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' turns USES into SUSE; 'inside' puts PO in it after the first S. 'flower' is a river, a thing that flows.
explanation.definitionFit: A husband or wife is a marriage partner.

parts.note: spectacular is a synonym of the first word, and a contact range is how close one must be to hit

explanation.surface: A dazzling range of contacts.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means close enough to hit or reach a target, i.e. within range of contact.

indicators.note: replanted means the letters of old man are set down again in a new order

explanation.surface: An elderly man has put the tree in somewhere new.
explanation.definitionFit: The nut-bearing Prunus dulcis is a tree.

clue.text: Being spherical, it will make ball go in all directions

indicators.note: in all directions means the letters of ball and go are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A round object will send a ball flying everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaped like a globe means round, i.e. spherical.

clue.text: It takes nuts and bolts through the trees!

definitions.text: It takes nuts and bolts through the trees!

parts.words: It takes nuts and bolts through the trees!
parts.note: nuts and bolts suggests hardware, but the creature takes nuts and bolts, i.e. dashes, through woodland

explanation.surface: Something carrying hardware through a forest.
explanation.definitionFit: The bushy-tailed rodent gathers nuts and darts among trees.

parts.note: came into line suggests agreeing, but here it is literally standing in a line

explanation.surface: Someone who agreed with everyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: Waiting in a line of people is standing in turn with others.

indicators.note: becoming tells us the letters turn into something else

parts.note: the dropped-aitch form of he's, giving E and S

explanation.surface: A Cockney chap quickly becoming the most protected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'becoming' shuffles E, S and FAST together.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative of safe: least at risk, the most secure.

parts.note: drop off sounds like falling, but here it means nodding off

explanation.surface: Something loosely attached.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone drowsy is ready to fall asleep.

explanation.surface: Something odd enough to get people talking.
explanation.definitionFit: Unusual means strange; literally, worthy of comment, able to be remarked on.

explanation.surface: Keeping something on to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To be dressed in clothes; also to endure, as good cloth does.

explanation.surface: The intellect of comedians.
explanation.definitionFit: Intelligence, as in keep your head; also clever, funny people.

indicators.note: in shows the letters are found within the words summer lingers

explanation.surface: A bird stays on through the summer.
explanation.definitionFit: A small falcon is a type of bird.

clue.text: Sauce and jam used in make-up

parts.note: lip is cheek, impudence, i.e. sauce
to jam is to stick fast

explanation.surface: Sauce and jam as cosmetics ingredients.
explanation.definitionFit: Coloured wax for the mouth is a cosmetic, part of make-up.
